title: adaptive-tenant-scrape-orchestrator-and-causal-link-proxy
creator: Ariana Gupta
description: Problem: Our existing metrics onramp assumes static scrape/topology configs and loses causal linkage between traces and aggregated LLM KPIs (per-route latency, cold-start counts, token cost). This causes difficulty debugging customer incidents and produces poor cardinality control for high-tenant workloads. Goal: Build an adaptive tenant scrape orchestrator + causal-link proxy that dynamically generates tenant-aware OTLP/Prometheus ingestion configs, scrubs PII/ephemeral labels, and injects trace/span identifiers into metric envelopes to preserve strong trace->metric correlation for SLOs and post-incident analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Adaptive generator can produce per-tenant scrape configs based on tenant profile (scale tier, allowed labels, retention policy) and apply them to the ingest fleet with zero-downtime rollout
Metric envelopes include a causal_link_id (derived from trace_id + request_slot) for >99% of inference requests without increasing p50 latency by more than 2ms
Label-scrubbing rules block at least three classes of PII (email, SSN patterns, long free-text blobs) per security policy and are configurable per-tenant
Ingest pipeline respects tenant-level cardinality caps to avoid high-cardinality storms (demonstrated in load test) and emits backpressure metrics/alerts
End-to-end test dashboards show correct joinability of traces and K8s aggregated latency heatmaps for three sample tenants in staging
technical_notes: Design: central controller generates JSON-based scrape manifests (OTel receiver and Prometheus relabel rules) and pushes to tenant-specific edge adapters via XDS-like API

Causal link: use a compact causal_link_id (base62 encoded trace_id prefix + per-request slot) attached as a metric label and as an exemplar reference to the trace span to support exemplar joins in Prometheus-compatible systems
Privacy: implement label scrubbing as an isolated wasm filter in the edge adapter so rules can be patched without runtime restarts
Backpressure: edge adapters implement token-bucket admission and report rejected metrics to a separate tenant-telemetry stream for billing/alerts
Failure modes: if edge adapter loses config, fallback to tenant-default sampling/labeling policy and emit incident event to console; no plaintext PII should be forwarded by default
implementation_plan: Week 1: Controller prototype that reads tenant profiles and emits scrape manifests. Create Confluence design doc and RFC.
Week 2: Edge adapter skeleton with wasm label-scrub hook and config hot-reload. Unit tests for pattern rules.
Week 3: Causal link injector instrumentation in inference gateway to emit per-request header for adapter to add as metric label and exemplar link. Bench microbench for p50 impact.
Week 4: Integration test in staging with three tenants (free, mid, enterprise) and synthetic high-cardinality traffic. Build dashboards and alert rules.
Week 5: Security review, docs for onboarding tenants, rollout to Canary region, collect metrics for 2 weeks, then GA
